name: cron
description: Emits an event on a schedule, so recurring work (a morning brief, a weekly review) arrives the same way a message does. Exposes tools so a bot can inspect its schedule, and — because schedules are stored as Sun instances — lets a bot create and delete its own.

settings.title: Schedule
settings.description: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Supports * , - / and ranges, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5" for weekday mornings.

settings.title: Prompt
settings.description: What to ask the bot each time the schedule fires.

settings.title: Time zone
settings.description: IANA name such as Europe/Berlin. Leave empty to use Sun's local time.

settings.title: Run once after downtime
settings.description: When Sun was stopped across a scheduled time, run the most recent missed schedule once at the next start. Off means a missed schedule is simply skipped.
